login.title: Chanɛl Hefatalɔ Botemɔ
login.welcome: Wɔhere bo atuu! Botemɔ mli koni okwɛ ohiɛnyiɛlɔi lɛ anɔ.
login.heroTitle: Ha oshiai ahe nitsumɔ lɛ aya hiɛ kɛ gbɛtsɔɔmɔ fɛɛ gbɛtsɔɔmɔ ni okɛbaa lɛ
login.heroIntro: Portal kome ni akɛbaaŋɔ mɛi ni heɔ nii lɛ awo tsumalɔi adɛŋ, ni akɛ credit aha mɛi ni nyiɛɔ osɛɛ lɛ ni anyiɛ amɛsɛɛ kɛyashi be mli ni amɛbaahe nii lɛ.

register.title: Ŋmalamɔ hiɛnyiɛlɔi yɛ sɛkɛndii fioo komɛi amli
register.text: Kɛ ohefatalɔ lɛ kɛ nitsumɔ ni amɛsumɔɔ lɛ amaje.

protect.title: Hebuu ni ji enyɔ
protect.text: Ohiɛnyiɛlɔ lɛ hiɔ onɔ kɛyashiɔ hebuu be lɛ mli, no hewɔ lɛ mɔ kroko nyɛŋ akɛɛ akɛ eji jarayelɔ kome too lɛ nɔŋŋ.

track.title: Nyiɛmɔ gbɛhe fɛɛ gbɛhe sɛɛ
track.text: Kwɛmɔ hiɛnyiɛlɔi lɛ ateŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ shihilɛ kɛ yinɔsane fɛɛ, kɛjɛ klɛŋklɛŋ ni akɛ lɛ kpe kɛyashi he ni ato lɛ.

handover.title: Credit yɛ he ni ato lɛ
handover.text: Kɛji akɛ jarayelɔ ko ŋma wolo lɛ, akɛ hiɛnyiɛlɔ lɛ haa tsumalɔ lɛ ni aŋmalaa bo awoɔ wolo nɔ akɛ jɛɛhe hefatalɔ.

login.secure: Botemɔ mli shweshweeshwe - ohefatalɔi ahe saji ahi teemɔŋ
login.builderLink: Kɛ ohe awo tsumalɔ lɛ shinaa lɛ mli

signup.title: Channel Hefatalɔi Agbɛi Wolo
signup.intro: Bɔɔ o-akaunt lɛ koni obɔi ogbɛi ŋmalamɔ kɛ bo diɛŋtsɛ ohefatalɔi lɛ akwɛmɔ.
